title: Failed break
description: On 7 Jul 21:00 price closes at 56,583, below the previous higher low (a bearish market structure break), and falls about 4% to 54,954, a lower low at level 1. The swing from the 57,261 high still completes: the 8 Jul 08:00 close of 57,770 breaks above it, so the upswing continues. That same close is a bullish market structure break, closing back above the lower high of the drop.
